title: System Administrator
description:
About Scaler AI Labs

Scaler AI Labs is Scaler’s frontier AI research and engineering division. We build Reinforcement Learning (RL) environments for the world’s leading AI research companies.

We operate at the intersection of product, engineering, and frontier AI, working closely with world-class AI researchers to build and deliver high-quality AI infrastructure and solutions. We move fast, maintain high engineering standards, and thrive in an environment that demands ownership, technical depth, and operational excellence.

Role Overview

We are looking for a hands-on
**IT Administrator**
to own and manage the organisation's IT infrastructure, end-user support, identity and access management, network operations, cloud security, and compliance requirements.

You will be responsible for ensuring seamless IT operations across the organisation, managing the complete employee IT lifecycle, maintaining secure and reliable infrastructure, and implementing scalable IT systems and processes.

The ideal candidate is technically strong, highly proactive, comfortable troubleshooting complex issues, and capable of independently managing IT operations in a fast-paced technology environment.

Key Responsibilities

1. IT Operations & End-User Support

* Own end-to-end IT support for employees, acting as the primary point of contact for all IT-related issues and requests.
* Manage L1, L2, and L3 troubleshooting across hardware, software, operating systems, applications, and connectivity.
* Handle employee onboarding and offboarding, including device provisioning, account creation, access provisioning, and access revocation.
* Troubleshoot issues related to Windows, macOS, VPN, Wi-Fi, email, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, and other enterprise applications.
* Manage IT helpdesk operations through ticketing platforms such as Jira Service Management or Freshservice.
* Establish and maintain IT support SLAs, ticket prioritisation processes, troubleshooting documentation, and knowledge bases.
* Identify recurring technical issues and implement permanent fixes and automation to reduce support overhead.

2. Identity & Access Management (IAM)

* Manage identity providers and directory services such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Google Workspace.
* Configure and maintain Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and authentication policies.
* Implement role-based access control (RBAC), least-privilege access, and secure access management practices.
* Manage the complete Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) lifecycle for employee access.
* Conduct periodic access reviews and audits to ensure appropriate access permissions.
* Manage privileged accounts, service accounts, shared credentials, and password vaults.

3. IT Asset & Device Management

* Own the complete lifecycle of IT assets, including procurement, inventory management, allocation, maintenance, recovery, and disposal.
* Maintain accurate hardware, software, and enterprise licence inventories.
* Manage endpoint devices across macOS and Windows environments.
* Implement and administer Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions such as Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or Kandji.
* Ensure endpoint security through device encryption, OS patching, security policies, antivirus, and remote device management.
* Manage device provisioning, configuration, tracking, and remote wiping.
* Monitor software licences, renewals, utilisation, and costs.

4. Network & Infrastructure Management

* Set up, configure, and maintain office network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and wireless access points.
* Manage LAN, WAN, VLAN segmentation, guest Wi-Fi, DNS, DHCP, and internet connectivity.
* Configure and maintain VPN and Zero Trust Network Access solutions such as Cloudflare, Tailscale, or Zscaler.
* Monitor network performance, troubleshoot connectivity issues, and ensure network availability.
* Manage ISP relationships, network redundancy, and infrastructure upgrades.
* Maintain network architecture documentation and implement appropriate network security controls.

5. Cloud Infrastructure & Security

* Support the setup and administration of cloud environments across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
* Configure cloud identity and access management, SSO, multi-account structures, and security guardrails.
* Implement secure cloud networking through VPCs, subnets, security groups, and firewall policies.
* Ensure encryption of data at rest and in transit, secure secrets management, and appropriate access controls.
* Configure centralised logging, monitoring, and security alerting using tools such as AWS CloudTrail, GuardDuty, and SIEM platforms.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, security reviews, and infrastructure audits.
* Support cloud security posture management (CSPM), disaster recovery, and business continuity initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams on Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) security reviews and Terraform-based infrastructure management.

6. Information Security & Compliance

* Drive IT security controls and operational readiness for compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
* Work with compliance platforms such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe to implement controls and collect audit evidence.
* Maintain IT security policies, access control documentation, asset registers, risk assessments, and audit trails.
* Coordinate internal and external security audits and ensure timely closure of identified gaps.
* Implement data protection, endpoint security, backup, and incident response procedures.
* Support GDPR requirements, including data access controls, vendor security reviews, and data protection processes.
* Support HIPAA-related security safeguards and compliance requirements wherever applicable to the organisation's operations.

7. IT Process Automation & Continuous Improvement

* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive IT operations, including onboarding, offboarding, access provisioning, and device management.
* Build scripts and workflows to improve operational efficiency.
* Evaluate and introduce IT tools, platforms, and solutions to improve employee experience and infrastructure reliability.
* Establish scalable IT processes, documentation, and standard operating procedures.
* Stay updated on emerging IT infrastructure, enterprise security, and cloud technologies.

What We Are Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience in IT Administration, IT Infrastructure, Systems Administration, or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on experience managing enterprise IT operations and end-user support.
* Experience administering Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID.
* Good understanding of macOS and Windows administration and endpoint management.
* Experience with MDM platforms such as Jamf, Intune, or Kandji.
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls, VLANs, and Wi-Fi infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, particularly around IAM and security configurations.
* Familiarity with information security frameworks such as SOC 2 and ISO 27001.
* Experience with IT ticketing systems and helpdesk management.
* Ability to troubleshoot technical issues independently and drive them through resolution.
* Strong ownership, problem-solving skills, documentation practices, and stakeholder management abilities.

Good to Have

* Experience working in a startup, SaaS, or fast-growing technology organisation.
* Experience managing IT infrastructure across multiple office locations.
* Familiarity with Zero Trust architecture and endpoint security solutions.
* Exposure to Terraform, scripting (Python, Bash, or PowerShell), and IT automation.
* Relevant certifications such as CompTIA Network+, Security+, Microsoft, AWS, or Google Cloud certifications.
* Experience supporting security audits and compliance certifications.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Solution Architecture and Design**

* Define the end-to-end technical architecture for enterprise solutions, from requirement gathering and discovery through design, build, testing, deployment, hypercare and production support.

* Produce reference architectures, patterns and reusable accelerators that can be applied across engagements.

* Oversee the design and optimisation of data platforms and pipelines: ingestion, ETL/ELT, orchestration, data modelling, data quality and lineage.

description:
**Company Description**
YoLabs is a mission-driven organization focused on delivering state-of-the-art technology and knowledge to learners at the earliest possible age. The team is dedicated to creating cutting-edge products in robotics and physical AI accessible and engaging.

**Role Description**
:

**We’re looking for 5 people who are a little obsessed with making machines move.**
🦾

At YoLabs we’ve spent years building robots, winning international competitions, and teaching thousands of students to create their own world. Now we’re going deeper — into
**Physical AI**
: intelligence that doesn’t just live on a screen, but senses, decides, and acts in the real world.

**What you’d actually do**

Whatever the frontier demands that week. There is no fixed lane. In the same month you might:

* Train teams for national & international robotics competitions
* Build technical solutions for new startups we’re backing
* Prototype cutting-edge ideas nobody’s cracked yet
* Work on YoLabs’ own spin-offs

One constant:
**you’re building robots, directly under the co-founders, responsible for anything and everything the work needs.**
No layers. No queue.

**Two ways in**

🔹
**If you’ve already built things**
— freshers up to 2 years, with a
*trail of evidence*
: competition robots (IIT TechFest, RoboCup, RCJ, MATE ROV, or your college/school arena), hobby builds, real projects that actually ran — apply for the
**team role.**

🔹
**If you’re not there yet but you love robots and want to learn**
— you’re genuinely welcome. Apply for the
**internship**
, and let’s find the synergy by building together.

Either door is a real door. We’ve all come through one of them.

**Who you are**

* Mechatronics, mechanical, electronics — or no “right” branch at all. Even a design background. We don’t care about the label.
* What we care about: you can
  *show*
  your love for robots, not just talk about it.
* Hands-on (or hungry to be) with Arduino, Raspberry Pi, Jetson, sensors, actuators, motors, ROS, computer vision, CAD.

**We hire builders, not toppers.**
A shining marksheet tells us nothing about whether you can make a thing work at 2 a.m. when the motor’s cooking and the code is lying to you. Show us what you’ve made.

**The honest part**

Tight timelines. Real deadlines. Some overnights when a build is close.

And then — we shut the lab, take a 5–7 day paid break, and go explore a corner of India together. That’s the rhythm. For the people this is written for, work-life balance isn’t a policy you negotiate — it happens on its own, because robots are already part of your life.

**Remuneration**
is based purely on your ability — and it’s served as
**salary plus ESOPs.**
You help build it, you own a piece of it.

**Apply if**
robots keep you up at night in the best way.
**Skip this**
if you need a fixed 9-to-6, a clean job description, or a predictable lane.

📍 Bengaluru · On-site

📩 CV + one thing you’ve built (photos, video, GitHub — anything) →
**venkatesh@yolabs.in**
or WhatsApp
**99459 66605**

Please avoid calls.

*Show us what you’ve made. That matters more than your marksheet.*

We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions.
  
  
Discover an unparalleled opportunity with nVent Management Company as an Oracle ERP System and Security Administrator in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India! Join us and be part of an ambitious team dedicated to advancing our innovative electrical solutions worldwide.
  
  
**What YOU WILL EXPERIENCE IN THIS POSITION**

* Security Administration
* Coordinate user security and role-based access controls within Oracle Fusion Cloud and Oracle EBS.
* Own day-to-day Oracle ERP security administration across Fusion Cloud and EBS R12.
* Design, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot role-based access controls.
* Build and govern Fusion Job Roles, Duty Roles, Privileges, Data Security Policies and Data Access.
* Administer EBS Responsibilities, Menus, Functions, Request Groups, Profile Options and Security Groups.
* Analyze access requirements and translate business roles into appropriate Oracle security models.
* Manage joiner/mover/leaver, provisioning, de-provisioning and access certification processes.
* Perform SoD analysis, identify conflicts, and coordinate remediation.
* Investigate complex authorization issues where users have the correct role but cannot access the expected transaction, data, BU, ledger, inventory organization or responsibility.
*  Partner with Cybersecurity, IAM, Internal Audit and business process owners on ERP access governance.
* Build, maintain, and govern security roles, responsibilities, menus, duties, and data access policies.
* Run onboarding, transfers, and termination access processes.
* Conduct Segregation of Duties (SoD) reviews and implement remediation activities.
* Support quarterly user access certifications and audit reviews.
* Investigate and resolve ERP security-related incidents and access issues.
* Partner with Cybersecurity and Internal Audit teams to maintain compliance with SOX and corporate security requirements.

Oracle Fusion Administration
  
  

* Coordinate Oracle Fusion security roles, duty roles, job roles, and data security policies.
* Support quarterly Oracle Fusion releases and security impact assessments.
* Coordinate testing and validation of role and security changes.
* Monitor environment health, integrations, and application availability.
* Support Identity Provider (IdP) integrations including Azure AD / Entra ID and Single Sign-On (SSO).

Oracle EBS R12 Administration
  
  

* Coordinate Oracle EBS responsibilities, users, menus, request groups, and profile options.
* Support instance refreshes, cloning activities, patches, and release deployments.
* Maintain workflow notifications, concurrent processing security, and access controls.
* Coordinate with DBAs, infrastructure teams, and led service providers on environment maintenance activities.
* Support EBS environment governance, system monitoring, and operational compliance.

Compliance & Governance
  
  

* Lead ERP access governance processes across Oracle environments.
* Handle and maintain SOX controls related to ERP security and system administration.
* Support internal and external audit requests.
* Document security standards, procedures, and operating controls.
* Maintain evidence repositories and compliance documentation.
* Take part in risk evaluations and corrective actions.

Operational Support
  
  

* Troubleshoot user account, access, authentication, and authorization issues.
* Support major ERP programs, acquisitions, carve-outs, site implementations, and ERP transformation initiatives.
* Assist with environment readiness, cutover planning, and deployment activities.
* Provide mentorship and training to business users regarding ERP security practices.
* Drive continuous improvement of security administration and governance processes.

**YOU Have**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, or related field, or equivalent experience
* Experience:
* 5+ years of Oracle ERP administration experience.
* Experience providing support for Oracle E-Business Suite and/or Oracle Fusion Cloud.
* Solid understanding of role-based security models and ERP access management.

**Experience Administering**

* Oracle EBS Responsibilities, Menus, Profile Settings, and Security Groups.
* Oracle Fusion Role-Based Security Framework.
* Single Sign-On and identity management platforms.
* Understanding of SOX controls, audit requirements, and segregation of duties principles.
* Experience with ERP user provisioning and access certification processes.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

**We Have**

* A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day

+ nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation.
+ Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com.

* Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work

+ We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide
+ Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money

- Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being:

* Innovative & adaptable
* Dedicated to absolute integrity
* Focused on the customer first
* Respectful and team oriented
* Optimistic and energizing
* Accountable for performance
* Benefits to support the lives of our employees

At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.

The Market Research & Intelligence (MR&I) team is a strategic thought partner that helps the business make smarter, faster decisions by translating customer, market, competitor, industry, and broader external signals into clear insights, strategic direction, risk awareness, and growth opportunities. **What You’ll Do**
As a Market Research & Competitive Intelligence Manager, you will partner with cross-functional leaders to translate business questions into rigorous research and intelligence approaches, synthesize evidence from multiple sources, and shape clear, objective recommendations for different stakeholders and business needs.
  
  
The role requires integrating insights across consumers, patients, physicians and other healthcare professionals, payers, customers, competitors, partners, and broader market forces. You will monitor current and emerging developments, connect disparate signals, distinguish meaningful change from market noise, and develop a well-supported point of view on what is changing, why it matters to Resmed, what remains uncertain, and what the business should consider next.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines deep market research expertise, strong investigative instincts, strategic business acumen, executive communication skills, and an experimental mindset toward AI and automation. The role will primarily support APAC - with emphasis on China and Japan and secondary support for Australia - while contributing to global MR&I priorities.

Market Research & Strategic Insights
  
  

* Independently lead end-to-end qualitative and quantitative market research projects from business-question definition through research design, vendor selection, questionnaire/discussion guide development, fieldwork, analysis, reporting, and executive presentation.

AI, Automation & MR&I Innovation

Strategic Partnership, Communication & Execution
